title: Biosurveillance source catalog
description: One record per public source of infectious-disease surveillance information in a country. The catalog says what a country publishes and where; it is not a feed of the measurements themselves and not a replacement for existing data standards (PHES-ODM for wastewater, the Global.health outbreak schema for case line lists, WHO SMART Guidelines).

checked.description: Date of the last pass over the sources.

record_class.description: dashboard: a public page or portal exists. measurement: a dated value we saved from a public source. reference: an authority page or a published study without running public data.

status.description: confirmed: we opened the source. listed_unconfirmed: listed by the EU or WHO, we could not open it. no_public_data: the page exists, no surveillance data found on it. historical: real data from a past period only.

detail.description: What the source covers, or the saved value with its unit and geographic coverage.

observed.description: Period the value refers to, or the date the page was opened. Never empty.

licence.description: Null means the licence was not checked, not that the data are free to reuse.

related_standard.description: Closest existing data standard for this signal type. A pointer only: the source has not been mapped to it.
